test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allowed.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **allowed **is a past form of the word allow which means to let (someone) have or do something.(अनुमति देना)
 
• *Example*: My mother **allowed **me to go for a picnic.
